description: Change an account webhook: url, events, description, or enabled (true turns it back on and clears its failure count). Needs a key.

enabled.description: true turns it on and clears failures, false pauses it

events.description: New event types or patterns (optional), e.g. ["feed.item.published"]

id.description: Webhook id from list_webhooks, e.g. wh_01JB2X3Y4Z

name: update_webhook
